hostPolicyReason: rightkit-fsindex has no Windows backend (crates/rightkit-fsindex/README.md:25, :159 'no Windows backend'); the public APIs are macOS-only.

ceilingSources.idleCpuPercent: declared 0.3.0 ceiling, process-wide, under dropped-event storms: crawl threads capped at 8 and shared per process (src/limits.rs MAX_CRAWL_THREADS), full rescans at most one per 30 s doubling to 10 min (RESCAN_COOLDOWN_BASE/MAX), subtree re-lists through a global bucket of 8 burst + 1 per 5 s (RELIST_BUDGET_*). Not yet measured.
ceilingSources.wakeupsPerSecond: declared 0.3.0 ceiling: FSEvents latency 500 ms (Config::watch_latency) gives at most 2 batches per second, plus one coalesce timer (Config::change_coalesce 1 s). Not yet measured.

caps.crawlThreadsScope: one budget per process, concurrent crawls queue

status.note: Status carries index-only resident_bytes (mapped+heap), process-wide cpu_percent, dir_reads_per_s; no wake-up count.

notes: 0.3.0 declares idle-CPU and wake-up ceilings from the new caps (see ceilingSources); they are declared, not measured. Resident-memory and disk-operation ceilings stay undeclared: no absolute figure is stated in docs or code, and a subtree re-list reads as many directories as the subtree holds. The gate refuses this crate until measurements are recorded. requiredScale is the bench's own default workload, cited in its source field.
